# Changelog

<!-- Generated by Docs/Update-ApiReference.ps1 from Docs/api-reference.json. Edit the release notes there. -->

Every release of the FluentLocalizer packages, newest first. The [WebUI changelog](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/changelog) shows the same notes with links to the API reference of each version.

## JSON store 1.0.1 (2026-10-11)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer.Store.Json`

Fixed neutral-culture fallback after manifest preloading in HttpJsonStore.

### Changed

- Updated the `HttpJsonStore.LoadAsync` API reference and package documentation to describe manifest-based neutral-culture preloading.

### Fixed

- With a manifest, `HttpJsonStore.LoadAsync` now preloads catalog files listed for the neutral culture too. Synchronous `GetTemplate` can therefore use the same neutral-culture fallback as `GetTemplateAsync` after preloading.

No public API changes in this version.

## Core 0.1.0-alpha (2026-09-30)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer`, `FluentLocalizer.Extensions.DependencyInjection`

Breaking namespace changes, mutable translation options and corrected dependency injection registration.

### Changed

- Breaking: the core types moved from `FluentLocalizer.Core` to `FluentLocalizer`, and the logging types from `FluentLocalizer.Core.Logging` to `FluentLocalizer.Logging`. See [Upgrading from 0.0.1](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/migration#namespaces).
- `TranslationOptions` properties have `set` accessors instead of `init`, so they can be configured in a dependency injection callback. See [TranslationOptions](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/migration#options).

### Fixed

- `AddFluentLocalizer(services, options)` registers the options object it receives, and both overloads validate their arguments against `null`. See [Dependency injection](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/migration#injection).
- `WithStore(store)` no longer registers the store twice.

## JSON store 0.1.0-alpha (2026-09-30)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer.Store.Json`

Dedicated JSON stores with shared settings, lazy loading, caching and HTTP refresh; the original JSON store was deprecated.

### Added

- [JsonFileStore](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/file), [EmbeddedJsonStore](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/embedded) and [HttpJsonStore](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/http), each with its own options class.
- `JsonStoreSettings`, the settings shared by every JSON store, including the `MaxDocumentBytes` size limit. See [Settings](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1#settings).
- Optional namespace files that split a catalog by feature. See [Namespaces](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1#namespaces).

### Changed

- The HTTP store, previously in the separate `FluentLocalizer.Store.Http` package, is now part of this package. See [Moving from FluentLocalizer.Store.Http](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/migration#from-http).

### Deprecated

- `JsonStore`, `JsonStoreOptions` and `JsonStoreLocation`. `JsonStore` now forwards every lookup to a `JsonFileStore` or an `EmbeddedJsonStore`. See [Deprecated APIs](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/migration#deprecated).

<details><summary>Public API changes (12)</summary>

- Added: `JsonStoreSettings`
- Added: `JsonFileStoreOptions`
- Added: `EmbeddedJsonStoreOptions`
- Added: `HttpJsonStoreOptions`
- Added: `JsonTranslationStoreBase`
- Added: `JsonFileStore`
- Added: `EmbeddedJsonStore`
- Added: `HttpJsonStore`
- Changed: `JsonStore` — Reimplemented as a compatibility wrapper over JsonFileStore or EmbeddedJsonStore and marked obsolete. Uses dedicated-store loading and validation; filesystem mode is rejected in browsers.
- Changed: `JsonStoreOptions` — Became sealed, inherited JsonStoreSettings and was marked obsolete. ThrowOnError was replaced by inherited ThrowOnMissingStore; FallbackCulture and FileMappings moved to the base class, which also adds MaxDocumentBytes.
- Deprecated: `JsonStore`
- Deprecated: `JsonStoreOptions`

</details>

## Core 0.0.1 (2026-07-30)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer`, `FluentLocalizer.Extensions.DependencyInjection`

First published release of the core and dependency injection packages.

### Added

- `ITranslator`, `Translator` and the fluent `TranslationBuilder`: arguments, plurals, gender, letter case and per-request cultures. See [Translation requests](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/requests).
- ICU message templates, formatted with the MessageFormat library, with `plural` and `select` blocks. See [Templates](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/templates).
- `TranslationOptions` policies for missing keys and formatting errors, and `TranslationException`. See [Errors and missing translations](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/errors).
- `ITranslationLogger` and `TranslationLogLevel` for translation events. See [Logging](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/logging).
- `ITranslationStore`, the contract implemented by every store. See [Custom stores](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/stores/custom).
- `AddFluentLocalizer()` and `FluentLocalizerBuilder` for Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection. See [Dependency injection](https://berik-99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/dependency-injection).

First release of these packages: every public API is new.

## JSON store 0.0.1 (2026-07-30)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer.Store.Json`

First published release of the JSON store package.

### Added

- `JsonStore` reads JSON catalogs from the file system or from embedded resources, selected by `JsonStoreOptions.SearchMode`.

First release of these packages: every public API is new.
